summary: Test-phase coverage and the OpenAPI implementation plan were added, but Swift is not installed in the container and the upstream dynamic OpenAPI endpoint is unavailable without a deployed Phoenix server.

references.result: Upstream issue #110 is closed, but no static spec exists in its main branch and the attempted raw spec fetch returned HTTP 404.
Local-stub tests cover manifest, recent sheets, capture creation, measurement upload, and judgment upload; generated operation names and ranked-results schema await the published document.
Replacement boundary is documented for the implementation run.
Tests use MockURLProtocol local stubs; execution was not possible because swift is absent.
PR-body delta checklist is recorded; the actual delta is blocked until a published spec can be fetched or vendored.
